mapper.select: SELECT id, cover_imgs, title FROM article WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, cover_imgs, title, sub_title, content, recommend, price FROM article WHERE id = #{tutorialId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article ( cover_imgs, title, sub_title, content, recommend, price, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{coverImgs}, #{title}, #{subTitle}, #{content}, #{recommend}, #{price}, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET cover_imgs = #{coverImgs}, title = #{title}, sub_title = #{subTitle}, content = #{content}, recommend = #{recommend}, price = #{price}, update_time = UNIX_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE article SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = UNIX_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{tutorialId} AND is_deleted = 0
